description:
We are TECH-UNJBG, a team of Mechanical Engineering students from Universidad Nacional Jorge Basadre Grohmann (Tacna, Peru). 

We are taking on the 'Flame in Freefall' challenge to analyze microgravity combustion data and improve fire safety in space missions. Our fully formed team combines strong skills in thermodynamics, data analysis, and problem-solving. 

We are driven by a shared passion for space exploration and ready to develop real aerospace solutions.
